pointwise_local_eigenline_without_forced.group_reason: every element of odd-dimensional SO(5) has an eigenvalue 1: reciprocal eigenvalue pairs leave one unpaired eigenvalue and determinant one forces it to be 1

pointwise_local_eigenline_without_forced.noncanonical_tensor_warning: the four cross roots resemble a 2-by-2 tensor product only after choosing and ordering two torus eigenvalue pairs; they do not define two global rank-two factors
